name: cut_two_modalities
title: Expectation value of an 18-qubit circuit that no single local QPU holds
description: A 6-qubit all-to-all coupling block followed by a 13-qubit shallow brickwork sharing one qubit; estimate a sum of Pauli correlators across both parts.
goal: Estimate the observable on the available QPUs (8-qubit ion trap, 16-qubit grid).
